description: This file implements the logic for cookie deletion criteria, including domain matching, time range handling, and cookie filtering based on various parameters within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo
classes.description: Represents criteria for deleting cookies, including time range, domain, name, value, URL, and partitioning filters.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange
classes.description: Defines a time interval with start and end times, and provides methods to check if a time is within the range.

methods.name: DomainMatchesDomains
methods.description: Checks if the effective domain of a cookie matches any domain in a given set.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given time falls within the time range.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::SetStart
methods.description: Sets the start time of the range.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::SetEnd
methods.description: Sets the end time of the range.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::Matches
methods.description: Determines if a given cookie matches the deletion criteria.
